Copy Markdown Open POST / api / v2 / bang Try in Playground Authorization Copy Anchor Link bearer header Authorization Bearer token Request Body Copy Anchor Link multipart/form-data body body … TypeScript asset_id ? string Copy Link **Parameters asset_id and model are mutually exclusive. Provide exactly one.** UUID of a completed Rodin generation task, taken from the top-level `uuid` of its generation response. Format uuid prompt ? string Copy Link Optional. Prompt used as additional reference. Only applies together with `model`. instruction ? string Copy Link Optional. Instruction for the bang task. Non-empty value will enable the instruction mode, and the model will be split based on the instruction. image ? unknown Copy Link Optional. Reference image for the custom model task when using `model`. Required for the following cases: - Using `model` when `material` is not `None` - Using `model` when using `instruction`. model ? unknown Copy Link **Parameters asset_id and model are mutually exclusive. Provide exactly one.** The model used for BANG. Supported model formats are obj , glb , stl , fbx , usd , usda , usdz , and usdc . strength ? integer Copy Link Controls the strength of the splitting of the model. The larger the value, the more pieces there will be. Range 1 = value = 12 Default 5 mesh_mode ? string Copy Link Optional. Control the mesh topology. - `Quad`：Quad faces mesh. - `Raw`：Triangle faces mesh. Default Raw Value in Quad Raw quality_override ? integer Copy Link Optional. Target face count across all output parts, not per part. Overrides the source asset setting. When omitted, uses Rodin Gen-2 medium quality: 18000 for Quad and 150000 for Raw, regardless of the source asset. Raw meshes are only simplified when above the target. In Quad mode, the worker caps the target at 50000 faces. Range 500 = value = 2000000 escore ? number Copy Link Controls texture complexity/richness in both `asset_id` and custom `model` modes. Higher values encourage more detailed textures; lower values produce cleaner, flatter textures. When an existing asset is used, this request value overrides its stored setting. Range 0 = value = 10 Default 3.5 reference_scale ? number Copy Link Controls how strongly texture generation follows the reference image in both `asset_id` and custom `model` modes. When an existing asset is used, this request value overrides its stored setting. Range 0 = value = 1 Default 0.5 seed ? integer Copy Link Random seed for generation. Optional; if omitted, a random seed is generated. Range 0 = value = 65535 geometry_file_format ? string Copy Link Optional. File format for the generated geometry files. Default glb Value in glb usdz fbx obj stl material ? string Copy Link Optional. Material type. - `PBR`: Physically Based Materials, including base color texture, metallicness texture, normal texture and roughness texture, providing high realism and physically accurate response to dynamic lighting. - `Shaded`: Only base color texture with baked lighting, providing stylized visuals. - `All`: Both PBR and Shaded will be delivered. - `Hybrid`: PBR texture maps with a base color texture that includes baked lighting. - `None`: Asset without material. This will speed up generation. Default PBR Value in PBR Shaded All Hybrid None resolution ? string Copy Link Optional. Texture generation resolution. - `Basic`: means 2K texture; - `High`: means 4K texture. Default Basic Value in Basic High Response Body Copy Anchor Link 201 application/json response response … TypeScript error ? string Copy Link Error code, if the request could not be submitted. This is returned in the response body alongside HTTP 201, so clients must check this field rather than relying on the HTTP status alone. This field is omitted on success. - `API_NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION`: the account has no active subscription. - `API_SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN_TOO_LOW`: the subscription plan does not allow API access. - `API_PARALLELISM_LIMIT_REACHED`: too many tasks are already in flight for the account. - `API_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS`: the account balance is insufficient for the request. - `API_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND_ON_IMAGE`: no object was detected in the input image. - `INVALID_REQUEST`: the request is malformed, missing required parameters, or contains invalid values. Check `message` for additional information. - `IMAGE_LABEL_LENGTH_TOO_LONG`: more `image_label` entries than uploaded images. - `IMAGE_CONTENT_VIOLATION`: the input image violates content requirements. - `NO_SUCH_TASK`: the referenced task does not exist or has expired. - `ASSET_NOT_AVAILABLE`: the referenced asset is not in an operable state. - `PERMISSION_DENIED`: the authenticated user may not perform this action. - `API_UNKNOWN`: an unexpected error occurred. Check `message` for additional information. Value in NO_SUCH_TASK ASSET_NOT_AVAILABLE IMAGE_LABEL_LENGTH_TOO_LONG INVALID_REQUEST API_NO_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION API_SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN_TOO_LOW API_PARALLELISM_LIMIT_REACHED API_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS API_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND_ON_IMAGE IMAGE_CONTENT_VIOLATION PERMISSION_DENIED API_UNKNOWN message ? string Copy Link Success message or detailed error information. uuid ? string Copy Link Unique identifier for the submitted generation task. Format uuid submit_time ? string Copy Link Server time when the task was submitted. Format date-time jobs ? object Copy Link A job object, containing details of individual jobs executed as part of the generation process. consumed ? number Copy Link Credits consumed by this request. Example Request cURL Copy Text curl -X POST https://api.hyper3d.com/api/v2/bang Example Response Schema 201 Copy Text { error : NO_SUCH_TASK , message : Submitted. , uuid : 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 , submit_time : 2019-08-24T14:15:22Z , jobs : { uuids : [ 52faea01-729e-4195-85e8-6050a65315e3 ], subscription_key : string }, consumed : 0.5 } Bang accepts exactly one of two input modes. Sending both asset_id and model , or neither, is rejected. Rodin asset input Copy Anchor Link Use the top-level uuid returned by a completed Rodin generation as asset_id . Required: asset_id . Optional: geometry_file_format , strength , material , resolution , seed , escore , and reference_scale . Mutually exclusive: model , image and prompt must be omitted. When material generation is enabled, escore and reference_scale apply in both input modes. Values sent with an asset_id override the corresponding settings stored on that asset; when omitted, the endpoint uses its request defaults. cURL Python Copy Text curl --fail-with-body --request POST https://api.hyper3d.com/api/v2/bang \ --header Authorization: Bearer ${ RODIN_API_KEY } \ --form asset_id=123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 \ --form strength=5 \ --form geometry_file_format=glb Custom model input Copy Anchor Link Upload one model. A reference image is required unless material is None , because material generation needs something to sample from; omitting it is rejected with INVALID_REQUEST and a descriptive message . Required: model , and image unless material=None . Optional: geometry_file_format , prompt , strength , material , resolution , reference_scale , escore , seed . Mutually exclusive: asset_id must be omitted. Supported model formats: obj , glb , stl , fbx , usd , usda , usdz , and usdc . strength accepts 1 to 12 and defaults to 5. Higher values split the model into more pieces. cURL Python Copy Text curl --fail-with-body --request POST https://api.hyper3d.com/api/v2/bang \ --header Authorization: Bearer ${ RODIN_API_KEY } \ --form model=@./model.glb \ --form image=@./reference.png \ --form prompt=Separate the main structural parts \ --form strength=5 \ --form geometry_file_format=glb Pricing Copy Anchor Link Every Bang request costs 0.5 credits , regardless of whether it uses a Rodin asset or an uploaded custom model and regardless of the selected input options. Response and errors Copy Anchor Link Copy Text { message : Submitted. , uuid : 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 , jobs : { uuids : [ 223e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 ], subscription_key : subscription-key-from-generation-response }, consumed : 0.5 } Bang uses the same application error codes as the other generation endpoints. HTTP 201 means the endpoint handled the request, but the task is accepted only when error is absent or empty and the top-level uuid is non-empty. HTTP 400 covers invalid fields, unsupported files, or conflicting input modes; 401 indicates invalid authentication; 429 indicates throttling. Poll and download using the same identifier rules as other generation endpoints. Rodin Gen-1/1.5 Generate a 3D asset with the Rodin Gen-1/1.5 tiers.
